mapper.insert: insert into user_message (user_id, send_user_id, msg_type, book_id, book_index_id, target_id, content, read_flag, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{sendUserId}, #{msgType}, #{bookId}, #{bookIndexId}, #{targetId}, #{content}, #{readFlag}, #{createTime})
